name: Zoom
description: The Sumo Logic App for Zoom provides visibility into how Zoom is being used across your organisation, displaying analytics on performance, availability, security, and user activity. The app aggregates and reports on data so you can correlate and investigate trends and respond to incidents across all of your IT tools in a consistent and timely manner.

children.name: Zoom - Adminstrator Activity
children.description: The Zoom - Administrator Activity dashboard provides insights into Administrative trends, user account activities, and user account trends.

panels.name: Admin Activity Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "event" ("account.created" or "account.disassociated" or "account.settings_updated" or "account.updated" or "user.settings_updated" or "user.updated" or "user.created" or "user.activated" or "user.deleted" or "user.deactivated" or "user.disassociated" or "app_deauthorized")
| json "event", "payload.operator", "payload.account_id", "payload.time_stamp" as event, admin, account_id, timestamp nodrop
| where event in ("account.created", "account.disassociated","account.settings_updated","account.updated", "user.settings_updated", "user.updated", "user.created", "user.activated", "user.deleted", "user.deactivated", "user.disassociated", "app_deauthorized")
| timeslice 1h
| count by event, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column event

panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "event" ("account.created" or "account.disassociated" or "account.settings_updated" or "account.updated" or "user.settings_updated" or "user.updated" or "user.created" or "user.activated" or "user.deleted" or "user.deactivated" or "user.disassociated" or "app_deauthorized")

| count by event
| sort by _count

panels.name: Recent Accounts Updated
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  ("account.updated" or "account.settings_updated")
| json "event", "payload.operator", "payload.account_id", "payload.object", "payload.old_object", "payload.time_stamp" as event, admin, account_id, new_object, old_object, update_timestamp
| where event in ("account.updated", "account.settings_updated")
| count by update_timestamp, admin, old_object, new_object
| replace(new_object, /\{|\}/, "") as new_object
| replace(new_object, /\:/, " => ") as new_object
| replace(new_object, /,/, "\n") as new_object
| replace(old_object, /\{|\}/, "") as old_object
| replace(old_object, /\:/, " => ") as old_object
| replace(old_object, /,/, "\n") as old_object
| sort by update_timestamp
| formatDate(fromMillis(update_timestamp),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as update_timestamp
| fields -_count
| limit 20

panels.name: User Events Distribution
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  ("user.created" or "user.activated" or "user.deleted" or "user.disassociated" or "user.deactivated" or "user.updated")
| json "event", "payload.account_id", "payload.creation_type", "payload.operator","payload.object.email", "payload.object.type" as event, account_id, creation_type, admin, user_email, user_type nodrop
| where event in ("user.created", "user.activated", "user.deleted", "user.disassociated", "user.deactivated", "user.updated")
| if (user_type == 1, "Basic", if(user_type == 2, "Licensed", if(user_type == 3, "On-prem", "Unknown"))) as user_type

panels.name: User Created/Activated

panels.name: Logins/Logouts Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  ("user.signed_in" or "user.signed_out")

| if (event == "user.signed_in", 1, 0) as logins
| if (event == "user.signed_out", 1, 0) as logouts

children.name: Zoom - Availability
children.description: The Zoom - Availability dashboard provides insights into meeting, webinar, and Zoom room alerts in your environment. A meeting alert event is triggered when a service issue is encountered during a meeting and a Zoom Room alert event is triggered when there is an issue related to a Zoom Room.

panels.name: Recent Meeting/Webinar Issues
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  ("meeting.alert" or "webinar.alert")
| json "event", "payload.object.start_time", "payload.object.topic", "payload.object.uuid", "payload.object.id", "payload.object.host_id", "payload.object.type", "payload.object.duration", "payload.object.issues" as event, meeting_start_time, topic, meeting_instance_id, meeting_number, meeting_host_id, meeting_type, meeting_duration, issues nodrop
| where event in ("meeting.alert", "webinar.alert")
| "Unknown" as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 1, "Instant Meeting", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 2, "Scheduled Meeting", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 3, "Recurring Meeting with No Fixed Time", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 4, "Meeting started with Personal Meeting ID", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 8, "Recurring Meeting with Fixed Time", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| count by meeting_start_time, meeting_number, meeting_host_id, topic, issues
| sort by meeting_start_time
| fields -_count
| limit 20

children.name: Zoom - Meeting Security
children.description: The Zoom - Meeting Security dashboard provides visibility into meeting security as it relates to frequently used meeting-id’s and personal meeting rooms, as well as monitor when meetings are updated in a way that don’t conform to security best practices.

panels.name: Top 10 Hosts with Personal Meeting Rooms
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "meeting.started"
| json "event", "payload.object.start_time", "payload.object.topic", "payload.object.uuid", "payload.object.host_id", "payload.object.id", "payload.object.type", "payload.object.duration" as event, meeting_start_time, topic, meeting_instance_id, meeting_host_id, meeting_number, meeting_type, meeting_duration nodrop
| where event = "meeting.started"
| where meeting_type == 4
| count(meeting_instance_id) as %"Count" by meeting_host_id
| top 10 meeting_host_id by  %"Count"

panels.name: Hosts Using Same Meeting Number
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "meeting.started"
| json "event", "payload.object.start_time", "payload.object.topic", "payload.object.uuid", "payload.object.id", "payload.object.host_id", "payload.object.type", "payload.object.duration" as event, meeting_start_time, topic, meeting_instance_id, meeting_number, meeting_host_id, meeting_type, meeting_duration
| where event = "meeting.started" and meeting_type not in (3, 8)
| "Unknown" as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 1, "Instant Meeting", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 2, "Scheduled Meeting", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 3, "Recurring Meeting with No Fixed Time", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 4, "Meeting started with Personal Meeting ID", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| if (meeting_type == 8, "Recurring Meeting with Fixed Time", meeting_type_desc) as meeting_type_desc
| count as %"Count" by topic, meeting_number, meeting_host_id
| where %"Count" > 1
| sort by %"Count" desc

panels.name: Hosts Using Personal Meeting Rooms Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "meeting.started"
| json "event", "payload.object.start_time", "payload.object.topic", "payload.object.uuid", "payload.object.host_id", "payload.object.id", "payload.object.type", "payload.object.duration" as event, meeting_start_time, topic, meeting_instance_id, meeting_host_id, meeting_number, meeting_type, meeting_duration nodrop

| where meeting_type == 4

panels.name: Recent Security Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "meeting.updated"
| json "event", "payload.object", "payload.operator", "payload.time_stamp", "payload.object.id" as event, object, user_email, update_time, meeting_number
| where event = "meeting.updated"
| formatDate(fromMillis(update_time),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as update_time

| "|" as security_event_type

| where security_event_type != "|"
| count by update_time, event, user_email, security_event_type
| fields -_count
